Shell(node -e " const fs = require('fs'); const html = fs.readFileSync('GradleProblemsReport.html', 'utf8'); const m = html.match(/\/\/ begin-report-data\n([\s\S]*?)\n\/\/ end-report-data/); if (!m) { console.log('no data found'); process.exit(1); } const data = JSON.parse(m[1]); const diags = data.diagnostics; console.log('total diagnostics:', diags.length); const bySev = {}; const byText = {}; for (const d of diags) { const sev = d.severity; bySev[sev] = (bySev[sev] || 0) + 1; const txt = d.problem.text; byText[txt] = (byText[txt] || 0) + 1; } console.log('by severity:', bySev); console.log('---'); for (const [t, n] of Object.entries(byText)) console.log(n + 'x', t); console.log('---'); // show a couple full entries to see locations/details for (const d of diags.slice(0, 3)) { console.log(JSON.stringify(d, null, 2)); console.log('===='); } ")

Shell(node -e " const fs = require('fs'); const html = fs.readFileSync('GradleProblemsReport.html', 'utf8'); const start = html.indexOf('// begin-report-data'); const end = html.indexOf('// end-report-data'); console.log('start idx:', start, 'end idx:', end); const segment = html.slice(start, end); // The JSON may have leading newline const firstBrace = segment.indexOf('{'); const json = segment.slice(firstBrace); const data = JSON.parse(json); const diags = data.diagnostics; console.log('total:', diags.length); const counts = {}; for (const d of diags) { const key = d.problem.text; counts[key] = (counts[key] || 0) + 1; } for (const [k, n] of Object.entries(counts)) console.log(n + 'x', k); console.log('--- severities:', JSON.stringify(diags.map(d=>d.severity))); ")
